problems: Portuguese Colonies (1564-1910) is merged into portuguese-empire, and both Names are in cliopatria_names. The group that owns portuguese-colonies (sa-06) should not write a second dossier, and the colour agent should alias portuguese-colonies to portuguese-empire. The umbrella components Portuguese Africa and Portuguese Ceylon are not mine to edit.

The empire overlaps kingdom-of-portugal on Ceuta (1415), Madeira (1419/1450) and the Azores (1427) and, in 1502, on Cape Verde, Tangier, Safi, São Tomé and Fernando Po; the compile step must decide which row draws them.

The Iberian Union (1581-1640) is modelled as a loss to spanish-empire in 1581 and a gain on 1 December 1640 (personal union with Portuguese autonomy, S11); spanish-empire needs the matching events or a personal-union tint.

The end year 1910 is a boundary of Cliopatria's Colonies row and a regime change, not the empire's end (S1 infobox runs to 1999); the Republic (portuguese-republic, 1911-1925) and Estado Novo continue it.
The page budget of 14 is fully spent; items no page dates are confidence 1 (20 of 86 events) or 'unverified: page budget' in keyframe notes.
Treaty_of_Madrid_(1750) loaded as a thin list page (signing date only); Treaty_of_San_Ildefonso_(1777) failed with URL_NOT_FOUND and First_Treaty_of_San_Ildefonso was used instead.

portuguese-empire_1619 has an intentionally empty correction (minus of the whole shape) because the shape holds only Essequibo and Albany, which are not Portuguese; the validator's 'resolves to no cells' warning for it is expected.
